faqs.question: How do I place an order?
faqs.answer: Browse products, add items to your cart, and click checkout. Enter your shipping and payment details to complete the purchase.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my order after placing it?
faqs.answer: Orders can be cancelled before they are shipped. Go to My Orders and select Cancel Order if the option is available.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Standard delivery typically takes 3–7 business days depending on your location.

faqs.question: Do you offer international shipping?
faqs.answer: Yes, we ship to selected international locations. Shipping costs and delivery times vary by destination.

faqs.question: How can I track my order?
faqs.answer: Once shipped, you will receive a tracking link via email and SMS. You can also track it under My Orders.

faqs.question: What payment methods are accepted?
faqs.answer: We accept credit cards, debit cards, UPI, net banking, wallets, and cash on delivery in eligible areas.

faqs.question: Is online payment secure?
faqs.answer: Yes, all transactions are encrypted using secure payment gateways compliant with industry standards.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: Items can be returned within 7 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging.

faqs.question: How do I initiate a return?
faqs.answer: Go to My Orders, select the item, and choose Return Item. Follow the instructions for pickup or drop-off.

faqs.question: When will I receive my refund?
faqs.answer: Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days after the returned item passes quality inspection.

faqs.question: How do I create an account?
faqs.answer: Click Sign Up, enter your email or phone number, and verify using the OTP sent to you.

faqs.question: I forgot my password. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Click Forgot Password on the login page and follow the reset instructions sent to your email.

faqs.question: How do I check product availability?
faqs.answer: Enter your delivery PIN code on the product page to see availability and delivery options.

faqs.question: Are product images accurate?
faqs.answer: We try to display products as accurately as possible, but slight variations may occur due to lighting or display settings.

faqs.question: How do I apply a coupon code?
faqs.answer: Enter the coupon code during checkout in the Apply Coupon field before payment.

faqs.question: Why is my coupon not working?
faqs.answer: Coupons may fail due to expiration, minimum order value, or product exclusions.

faqs.question: How do I contact customer support?
faqs.answer: You can reach us via live chat, email support, or the Help Center available on our website.

faqs.question: What are customer support hours?
faqs.answer: Customer support is available 24/7 through chat and email.

faqs.question: My order shows delivered but I did not receive it.
faqs.answer: Please contact support within 48 hours so we can investigate with the delivery partner.

faqs.question: Do products come with warranty?
faqs.answer: Warranty coverage depends on the brand and product. Details are listed on the product page.
